name: List Harbor
intro: Crates move on belts here, one after another.
A queue is a line of things. This harbor loves lines.
Welcome to List Harbor. Order matters.

1: Crates slide in from both ends.
The belt is a line of waiting items.
Things go in, and things come out.
One side is left. One side is right.
2: A list keeps things in order.
You push into a list at one end.
You pop out of a list at an end.
Lists are lines, and lines have order.

error: That crate does not fit there.

curiosity: What else could ride this belt?
Push more and watch the line grow.
humor: This queue moves faster than city traffic.
Left, right... the belt has no favorites.
Even a dragon waits its turn here.
wisdom: Order is the whole game in a list.
First in, first out. Or last in, first out.
Push and pop, and the line obeys you.
sternness: Pick a side. Left or right.
A queue is not a pile. Respect it.
